title: Best planner I’ve found so far!
body:
Honestly, Daily planner is the best planner and task checklist app I have ever seen. It makes managing daily tasks incredibly easy and has really helped me stick to my habits without feeling overwhelmed. The interface is intuitive and user-friendly.
The only downside for me is my own budget—I really wish I could afford the premium features to unlock the full potential of the app. However, even the free version is a fantastic tool. Highly recommended!

title: ملاحظة
body:
مرحبًا البرنامج جميل جدًا ولذيذ، ولكن، لو وُضِعَت أيام الأسابيع كل يوم على حدة، بمعنى أنني أسجل، مغرب يوم بعد غد وما إلى ذلك.. وكذلك لو صارت الأوقات على مغرب عصر عشاء صبح لكان أفضل.. بالإضافة إلى أنه من الجيد جدًا أن يكون بدء التذكير قبل الوقت بساعات، حتى لا يكون فيه انشغال حين المهمة.. كذلك، لو صار فيه تنبيه صباحي للمهام اليومية.. بمعنى أني أسجل بالليل مهام غدًا، ثم يوم غدًا وأول ما أستيقظ، يكون فيه تنبيه للبرنامج اليومي كامل اللي أنا مسجله..
بالإضافة إلى حاجة التطبيق أن يكون له رنَّة خاصة فيه تنبِّه بالمهام .. 
شكرًا على ما تقدمونه🌹.

title: I love this App
body:
I’ve been looking for a daily planner that fits my need and cannot find a better app than this one, thank you for your efforts.

I have bought the full access for this app day 1, it was worth every cent and it was like finding a treasure.

Things I love:
- very simple and beautiful UI, really easy to start planning without distractions.
- using this app is very intuitive, everything is exactly where you thing it will be, and everything you think it will be there you will find.
- although this app may look simple, but the feature set is rich and all the features is exactly what you need, no extra features that may be overwhelming and some times distracting.
- i love the habit tracker, and really looks nice to focus on tasks without worrying about crowding the task list

Things i wish to be added:
- as i use Trello very often, i thing one list item can have 2 options for example, you chose to be a board or the normal task list, nothing fancy, just a board with columns and moveable cards would suffice. Like a mini Trello 

Things for improvements:
- i am using the iPad with the magic keyboard, when adding a task i have to click enter as the done button is overplayed with the iPad text input

Overall, Job Well done
